nl: 发货单管理：查询有订单号；表格展示订单号、收货地址、开票地址；支持新增、编辑、删除。表单里「开票地址」在与收货地址相同时隐藏（默认一致）。
nlEn: Delivery-note management: query by order number; the table shows order number, shipping address and billing address; supports add, edit and delete. In the form, the "billing address" is hidden when it is the same as the shipping address (same by default).
notes: AI-16: 表达式 isHidden（跨字段相等比较）—— 开票地址与收货地址相同时隐藏（vue3/schema）
